name: @mxlang/core
description: MX core: compiles .mx templates on Marko's parser, shared by every target

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @marko/compiler --external @babel/parser --external htmljs-parser --define MX_MARKO_FRONTEND='"./marko-frontend.cjs"' && bun build/frontend.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
